findings.vision_section: One-liner / Chief of Staff / Proactive behavior [VISION §'One-liner']
findings.assessment: STRONGLY ALIGNED. All three pipelines are named explicitly or by clear description in WHAT-IS-ADMINISTRATEME.md. custody_brief appears verbatim in the 'Day in your AdministrateMe household' diagram: '8:00 PM — Custody brief composed for tomorrow'. crm_surface directly implements 'the system surfaces who you're drifting from before you notice' (landing page §3 CRM section). reminder_dispatch directly implements 'proactively does what matters' for commitment obligations. The six-pipeline proactive roster (morning_digest + paralysis_detection + reward_dispatch + reminder_dispatch + crm_surface + custody_brief) is the literal implementation of the 'household chief-of-staff that... proactively does what matters' one-liner.

ALIGNED. reminder_dispatch directly reduces the executive-function load of tracking upcoming commitments — a canonical ADHD failure mode (the 'I knew it was due, I just didn't act' pattern). crm_surface reduces relationship-maintenance cognitive load ('the birthday you keep forgetting'). The per-row defensive-default on skill failure (one row's failure does not abort the full tick, only that row is skipped) is ADHD-safe: partial success over all-or-nothing aligns with the 'endowed progress' principle from the vision. crm_surface's default-false opt-in is also ADHD-appropriate: avoiding unsolicited CRM noise before the member has opted in reduces distraction.

ALIGNED. [D22] cited throughout the Operating Context; all three pipelines explicitly required to route through outbound.dispatcher.deliver gated on InstanceConfig.observation_mode. The composed event (*.composed) still lands in the event log even when delivery is suppressed — the audit trail is intact for trust-building during the observation period. This is the exact vision promise: 'For 7 days, you review what the system would have sent. When you trust what it would have done, you flip observation off.' No outbound bypass is specified or implied anywhere in the prompt.

findings.vision_section: Privacy-first / self-hosted [VISION §'It runs in your house']
findings.assessment: ALIGNED. No LLM SDK imports [D6]; all skill calls through OpenClaw's ctx.run_skill_fn [§8.9]; no hardcoded tenant identity [§12.4]; verify_invariants.sh exit 0 mandatory in Commit 4. The three new event types carry causation_id=tick_event.event_id (the proactive-pipeline causation pattern from 10c-i), making every LLM-produced composition traceable to a replayable standing-order tick — consistent with the event-sourced privacy promise ('every piece of LLM-derived state in the system is traceable to a replayable call').

ALIGNED. custody_brief is explicitly scoped to members with coparent_relationship_member_id set — the cross-household coparenting scenario is a named target audience in the vision ('Coparents managing custody, school, medical, and child-related logistics across two households'). crm_surface is per-member (not household-global), preserving per-member privacy boundaries. reminder_dispatch supports per-member overrides including reminders_enabled opt-out.

ALIGNED. The Commit 4 BUILD_LOG template's carry-forwards are vision-grounded: Phase B smoke test verifies real-world pipeline behavior (not just sandbox mocks — the vision is a live household system); console audit-trail carry-forward enables the observation-period review flow; bootstrap wizard carry-forward enables correct per-member personalization (the vision's 'set up member profiles' wizard section). None are purely defensive-coding carry-forwards. The 'soft-watch for future' items in the BUILD_LOG template (dedupe helper extraction at 3+ pipelines, per-member-overrides config extraction at 6+ pipelines) correctly defer premature abstraction until the pattern recurs — aligned with the build's 'three similar lines is better than a premature abstraction' discipline.
